descriere: Sets the access level to read and write parameters.
Sets the parameter filter to commission a drive. Setting this parameter filters out the parameters that can be written into in the various commissioning steps.
Runs the corresponding macro files.
Setting to reset the display in r0039 and r0041. Procedure: Set p0040 = 0 --> 1 The displays are reset and the parameter is automatically set to zero.

Defines whether the motor and drive converter power settings (e.g. rated motor power, p0307) are expressed in [kW] or [hp]. Depending on the selection, the rated motor frequency (p0310) is either set to 50 Hz or 60 Hz. For p0100 = 0, 2, the following applies: The power factor (p0308) should be parameterized. For p0100 = 1, the following applies: The efficiency (p0309) should be parameterized.
Sets the number of Command Data Sets (CDS).
Sets the number of Drive Data Sets (DDS).
The duty cycles can be overloaded provided that the drive converter is operated with its base load current before and after the overload. This is based on a load duty cycle of 300 s.
Sets the drive unit supply voltage (rms value of the phase-to-phase line supply voltage).
Sets the braking power of the connected braking resistor.
Sets the type of the filter at the motor side.
Enter the inductance of a filter connected at the power unit output.
Enters the capacitance of a sine-wave filter connected at the power unit output.

Sets the response to a thermal overload condition of the power unit. The following quantities can result in a response to thermal overload: - heat sink temperature (r0037.0) - chip temperature (r0037.1) - power unit overload I2T (r0036) Possible measures to avoid thermal overload: - reduce the output current limit r0289 and r0067 (for closed-loop speed or torque control) or the output frequency (for U/f control) indirectly via the output current limit and the intervention of the current limiting controller). - reduce the pulse frequency. A reduction, if parameterized, is always realized after an appropriate alarm is output.
Sets the fan run-on time after the pulses for the power unit have been canceled.
Sets the technology application. The parameter influences the calculation of open-loop and closed-loop control parameters that is e.g. initiated using
Setting to inhibit the calculation of reference parameters (e.g. p2000) when automatically calculating the motor and closed-loop control parameters (p0340, p3900).
Selects the units for the parameters of the technology controller. For p0595 = 1, 2, the reference quantity set in p0596 is not active.
Sets the reference quantity for the technological units. When changing over using changeover parameter p0595 to absolute units, all of the parameters involved refer to the reference quantity.
Sets the debounce time for digital inputs.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DO 1
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DO 1 (NO: T. 21).
Setting to invert the signals at the digital outputs.
Sets the simulation mode for digital inputs.

descriere_scurta: CU digital inputs simulation mode setpoint
descriere: Sets the setpoint for the input signals in the digital input simulation mode.

descriere_scurta: Data transfer: memory card as source/target
descriere: Sets the number for data transfer of a parameter backup from/to memory card. Transfer from memory card to device memory (p0804 = 1): - Sets the source of parameter backup (e.g. p0802 = 48 --> PS048xxx.ACX is the source). Transfer from non-volatile device memory to memory card (p0804 = 2): - Sets the target of parameter backup (e.g. p0802 = 23 --> PS023xxx.ACX is the target).

descriere_scurta: Data transfer: device memory as source/target
descriere: Sets the number for data transfer of a parameter backup from/to device memory. Transfer from memory card to device memory (p0804 = 1): - Sets the target of the parameter backup (e.g. p0803 = 10 --> PS010xxx.ACX is the target). Transfer from non-volatile device memory to memory card (p0804 = 2): - Sets the source of the parameter backup (e.g. p0803 = 11 --> PS011xxx.ACX is the source).

Sets the transfer direction and start of data transfer between the memory card and non-volatile device memory. Example 1: The parameter backup is to be transferred from the device memory to the memory card with setting 0. The parame- ter backup is to be stored on the memory card with setting 22.

descriere_scurta: Command data set selection CDS bit 0
descriere: Sets the signal source to select the Command Data Set bit 0 (CDS bit 0).

Displays or sets the PROFIBUS address for PROFIBUS interface on the Control Unit. The address can be set as follows: 1) Using the DIP switch on the Control Unit. --> p0918 can then only be read and displays the selected address. --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON. 2) Using p0918 --> Only if all of the DIP switches are set to ON or OFF. --> The address is saved in a non-volatile fashion using the function "copy from RAM to ROM". --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON.
Sets the send and receive telegram.
Number of fault situations that have occurred since the last reset.
Displays the system runtime in ms since the last POWER ON.

The parameter is used to initiate the reset of the drive parameters. Parameters p0100, p0205 are not reset. The following motor parameters are defined in accordance with the power unit: p0300 ... p0311. When downloading settings 10, 11, 12, the buffer memory mode is automatically deactivated (p0014 = 0).
Setting to save parameters in the non-volatile memory. When saving, only the adjustable parameters intended to be saved are taken into account.
Sets the required procedure to execute a hardware reset for the drive unit.
Sets the mode to select the fixed speed setpoint.
Sets the automatic restart mode (AR). The parameters must be saved in the non-volatile memory p0971 = 1 in order that the setting becomes effective.
Sets the start attempts of the automatic restart function for p1210 = 4, 6, 14, 16, 26.

descriere_scurta: Automatic restart delay time start attempts
descriere: Sets the delay time up to restart.
Sets the holding brake configuration.
Sets the time to open the motor holding brake. After the holding brake has been controlled (opened), the speed setpoint remains at zero for this time. After this, the speed setpoint is enabled.

Sets the time to apply the motor holding brake. After OFF1 or OFF3 and the controlling (closing) of the holding brake, the drive remains stationary under closed- loop control for this time with a speed setpoint of zero. The pulses are suppressed when the time expires.

descriere_scurta: Vdc_max controller automatic ON level detection
descriere: Activates/de-activates the automatic sensing of the switch-in level for the Vdc_max controller.

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover speed hysteresis encoderless operation /
descriere: Sets the hysteresis for the changeover speed of the motor model for encoderless operation.

descriere_scurta: Motor data identification and rotating measurement
descriere: Sets the motor data identification and speed controller optimization. The motor identification should first be performed with the motor stationary (p1900 = 1, 2; also refer to p1910). Based on this, additional motor and control parameters can be determined using the motor data identification with the motor rotating (p1900 = 1, 3; also refer to p1960).
Sets the motor data identification routine. The motor data identification routine is carried out after the next power-on command.

Sets the rotating measurement. The rotating measurement is carried out after the next power-on command. The setting possibilities of the parameter depend on the open-loop/closed-loop control mode (p1300).
Sets the speed to determine the saturation characteristic. The percentage value is referred to p0310 (rated motor frequency).

Sets the speed for the identification of the moment of inertia and the vibration test. Induction motor: The percentage value is referred to p0310 (rated motor frequency). Synchronous motor: The percentage value is referred to the minimum from p0310 (rated motor frequency) and p1082 (maximum speed).
Sets the dynamic response factor for speed controller optimization.

Sets the reference quantity for speed and frequency. All speeds or frequencies specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). The following applies: Reference frequency (in Hz) = reference speed (in ((rpm) / 60) x pole pair number)

Sets the reference quantity for voltages. All voltages specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. This also applies for direct voltage val- ues (= rms value) like the DC-link voltage. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for currents. All currents specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for torque. All torques specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for temperature. All temperatures specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).
Sets the address for the commissioning interface (USS, RS232).
Sets the baud rate for the field bus interface (RS485).

Displays or sets the address for the fieldbus interface (RS485). The address can be set as follows: 1) Using the address switch on the Control Unit. --> p2021 displays the address setting. --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON. 2) Using p2021 --> Only if an address of 0 or an address which is invalid for the fieldbus selected in p2030 has been set using the address switch. --> The address is saved in a non-volatile fashion using the function "copy from RAM to ROM". --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON.

descriere_scurta: Field bus int USS PZD no.
descriere: Sets the number of 16-bit words in the PZD part of the USS telegram for the field bus interface.

descriere_scurta: Field bus int USS PKW no.
descriere: Sets the number of 16-bit words in the PKW part of the USS telegram for the field bus interface.
Sets the communication protocol for the field bus interface.

Sets the processing mode for PROFIdrive STW1.10 "master control by PLC". Generally, control world 1 is received with the first receive word (PZD1) (this is in conformance to the PROFIdrive profile). The behavior of STW1.10 = 0 corresponds to that of the PROFIdrive profile. For other applications that deviate from this, the behavior can be adapted using this particular parameter.

The serial interface for the debug monitor is COM1 (commissioning interface, RS232) or COM2 (fieldbus interface, RS485). Value = 0: De-activated Value = 1: COM1, commissioning protocol is de-activated Value = 2: COM2, field bus is de-activated Value = 3: Reserved
Sets the monitoring time to monitor the process data received via the fieldbus interface. If no process data is received within this time, then an appropriate message is output.
Sets the PROFIBUS Ident Number (PNO-ID).

Sets the delay time to initiate fault F01910 after a setpoint failure. The time until the fault is initiated can be used by the application. This means that is is possible to respond to the failure while the drive is still operational (e.g. emergency retraction).

Sets the additional monitoring time to monitor the process data received via PROFIBUS. The additional monitoring time enables short bus faults to be compensated. If no process data is received within this time, then an appropriate message is output.
Sets the send and receive telegram. Contrary to p0922, a telegram can be selected using p2079 and subsequently expanded.
Number of alarms that have occurred after the last reset.
Sets the mode for using the technology controller output.
Sets the scaling for the setpoint 1 of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling for the setpoint 2 of the technology controller.
Sets the ramp-up time of the technology controller.
Sets the ramp-down time of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller setpoint filter time constant
descriere: Sets the time constant for the setpoint filter (PT1) of the technology controller.
Sets the technology controller type.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller actual value filter time constant
descriere: Sets the time constant for the actual value filter (PT1) of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller upper limit actual value
descriere: Sets the upper limit for the actual value signal of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller lower limit actual value
descriere: Sets the lower limit for the actual value signal of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling factor for the actual value of the technology controller.
Setting to use an arithmetic function for the actual value signal of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller actual value inversion (sensor type)
descriere: Setting to invert the actual value signal of the technology controller. The inversion depends on the sensor type for the actual value signal.
Sets the time constant for the differentiation (D component) of the technology controller.
Sets the proportional gain (P component) of the technology controller.
Sets the integral time (I component, integrating time constant) of the technology controller.
Sets the maximum limit of the technology controller.
Sets the minimum limit of the technology controller.
Sets the ramping time for the output signal of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling for the output signal of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller output signal starting value
descriere: Sets the start value for the output of the technology controller. If the drive is switched on and the technology controller is already enabled (see p2200, r0056.3), then it's output sig- nal r2294 first goes to the start value p2302, before the controller starts to operate.
Setting to invert the fault signal of the technology controller. The setting depends on the type of control loop.
Sets the two wire control/three wire control.
Exits quick commissioning (p0010 = 1) with automatic calculation of all parameters of all existing drive data sets that depend on the entries made during quick commissioning.
For service personnel only.
Setting to acknowledge all active faults of a drive object.
Sets the mode to change over the master control / LOCAL mode.
Sets the general properties for energy-saving.

descriere_scurta: Pe set switch-on inhibit signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source to set in the PROFIdrive state S1 "switching-on inhibit".
Setting for activating/de-activating the write protection for adjustable parameters.

descriere_scurta: Write protection multi-master fieldbus system access behavior
descriere: Sets the behavior for write protection when accessing via multi-master fieldbus systems (e.g. CAN, BACnet).
